facts.claim: The prevailing soil in Bangalore is red, on which ragi and other dry crops are cultivated.
facts.quote: The prevailing soil is the red, on which are cultivated ragi and the commonly associated dry crops.

facts.claim: Paddy and sugar-cane are grown on lands under tanks near Bangalore.
facts.quote: Paddy and sugar-cane are grown on the lands under tanks.

facts.claim: The revenue settlement was introduced into the Bangalore, Agsira, Halsur and Yesvantpur hoblis in 1872.
